sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a firefly character. Draw this exact firefly as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the head: the round brown head, facing left as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; no antennae.
2. one antenna: a thin dark antenna with its glowing yellow tip.
3. the body: the brown body with its red-orange collar, without head, wings, legs or the glowing tail.
4. the glowing tail: the round glowing yellow tail end, alone.
5. one wing: the clear veined wing as in image 1, with a rounded root.
6. one leg: a thin dark jointed leg with a little foot, bent as in image 1.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a firefly character; image 2 shows the same firefly cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the firefly's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the firefly in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the firefly's left eye (on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a big dark round eye with a white sparkle.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile.
7. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
8. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
9. the mouth in a small sad frown.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the firefly lifts one front leg and waves hello, smiling, its wings giving a happy little buzz, then puts the leg down and does a happy little bounce.

pause.shows: the firefly waving hello, one front leg raised high, smiling

animations.description: the firefly flies along to the left, wings buzzing and tail glowing, then lands.
the firefly walks along to the left on its six little legs, wings folded and tail glowing softly, then stops.
the firefly buzzes its wings fast, whirring up a little off the ground, then settles back down.
the firefly crouches, jumps up high for joy with a buzz of its wings, and lands with a little squash.
the firefly does a happy little dance, swaying from side to side and tapping its little legs.
the firefly shakes its head no.
the firefly looks one way, then the other, then back.
the firefly laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles.
the firefly talks, its mouth moving, its head bobbing a little.
the firefly shivers and trembles, cold or scared.
the firefly cries, head down, shoulders shaking with little sobs.
the firefly gives a big yawn, closes its eyes and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.
